name: Lenggries (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically green and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Lenggries (a white stag on green).
history: Municipal flag of Lenggries; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Lenggries arms — white stag on green
